byte_evidence.method: Individually interpreted wrapper calls, parsed attributable input_text JSON bodies and unwrapped Promise.allSettled fulfilled.value where used. Sum UTF-8 bytes of decoded exec_command.output only; shell protocol and Script completed envelopes excluded. Source searches/listings included, bootstrap/edit/test bodies excluded. No captured inputs executed.

notes: All recorded task shell commands start rtk and set workdir to the assigned trial root. Commands and imports target files in that root; only mandatory RTK bootstrap reads outside it. No forbidden retrieval, internet, delegation, global/index search, prior results, reference or grader reads observed. Scope verified against captured operations and passing provenance, not filesystem syscall tracing.

Actual nested calls counted individually, including sequential and Promise.allSettled calls. Tool-name strings in source/searches/test input are data and were not counted as calls. No failed calls or retries.
Bytes measure decoded returned text, not model tokens or causal savings. Quality checks are separate and grades unchanged.
Available treatment conforms with zero aide uptake. No edits or test executions; read-only navigation integrity passes. All 9 task calls are source exploration.
